cohort: The study included late pregnant women (n=7-9 per group) undergoing caesarean delivery, categorized by maternal age (<35 years or ≥35 years), from whom omental fat biopsies were obtained.
finding: Omental arteries from women of advanced maternal age were less compliant (lower circumferential strain) and had lower elastin levels, leading to a greater collagen:elastin ratio, compared to arteries from younger women.
